en.answer: In the given situation, the part that Special Summons <<15858>> itself cannot be applied, so the part that negates the activated effect is not applied either, and <<15858>> that activated the effect will remain in your hand.
en.question: What happens if the effect of <<9153>> is applied when resolving the effect of <<15858>>?
en.title: What happens if the effect of <<9153>> is applied when resolving the effect of <<15858>>?

ja.answer: その場合、『このカードを手札から特殊召喚し』の処理を適用できませんので、『その効果を無効にする』処理も適用されません。この効果を発動した「<<15858>>」は手札に残ります。
